headlines.description: Kevin De Bruyne netted in his debut and Scott McTominay scored the opener as Napoli kicked off their Serie A title defence with a 2-0 win over Sassuolo.
headlines.shortLinkText: De Bruyne scores on Serie A debut in Napoli win

headlines.description: Inter Milan got their Serie A campaign off to the perfect start when Marcus Thuram scored twice in a comfortable 5-0 win over dismal Torino on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter smash Torino 5-0 to start Serie A in style

headlines.description: USMNT forward Christian Pulisic came off the substitutes' bench to seal AC Milan's win at Leece.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic scores off bench as Milan get 1st win

headlines.description: Inter Milan slipped to a 2-1 home defeat as Udinese came from behind to take the points at the San Siro.
headlines.shortLinkText: Udinese rally to stun Inter Milan at San Siro

headlines.description: It was Khephren Thuram who ended up celebrating after his Juventus side snatched a 4-3 win over Inter Milan in a thrilling Derby d'Italia on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thuram bros score as Juve beat Inter in wild derby

headlines.description: Rasmus Højlund marked his Napoli debut with a goal as they eased to a 3-1 win away to Fiorentina to extend their perfect start to the Serie A campaign.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund scores 14 mins into winning Napoli debut

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic scored twice in Milan's win over Udinese to surpass Clint Dempsey's record for goals by a U.S. international in Europe's top five leagues.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic tops Dempsey's U.S. goal mark in Milan win

headlines.description: Nothing seemed to be going Lorenzo Pellegrini's way. Until he scored the winner in the Rome derby.
headlines.shortLinkText: Outcast Pellegrini scores winner in Rome derby

headlines.description: Lautaro Martínez showed he has fully recovered from a back problem as he set Inter on the way to a 2-0 victory at Cagliari on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lautaro goal helps Inter to win over Calgiari

headlines.description: Napoli slipped from the top of Serie A after falling to a 2-1 defeat to 10-man AC Milan at the San Siro.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic on target as Milan beat Napoli to go top

headlines.description: Napoli returned to winning ways in Serie A by coming from behind to beat struggling Genoa 2-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund scores again as Napoli go top of Serie A

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic missed a penalty as AC Milan and Juventus played out a goalless draw at the Allianz Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic misses penalty as Juve and Milan draw

headlines.description: Noa Lang's stoppage time equalizer was ruled out for offside and Napoli lost at Torino 1-0 in Serie A on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Napoli lose at Torino after VAR rules out late goal

headlines.description: Ange-Yoan Bonny sent Inter Milan top of Serie A as he struck early to down Roma 1-0 at the Stadio Olimpico.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bonny sends Inter Milan top with win over Roma

headlines.description: Zachary Athekame scored with a long-range drive in injury time to rescue a 2-2 draw for Serie A leader AC Milan against bottom club Pisa on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milan rescue late draw without injured Pulisic

headlines.description: Napoli put back-to-back defeats behind them by returning to the top of Serie A after a 3-1 statement win against title rivals Inter Milan.
headlines.shortLinkText: Napoli beat Inter to return to Serie A summit

headlines.description: Despite mounting injury problems, Napoli moved clear at the top of Serie A with a 1-0 win at Lecce on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Injury-hit Napoli edge Leece to go clear at top

headlines.description: Igor Tudor's firing at Juventus produced an immediate result.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juventus end winless run following Tudor firing

headlines.description: It took all of 85 seconds for Juventus to score their first goal under Luciano Spalletti.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spalletti wins in Juve debut despite Vardy goal

headlines.description: Martin Frese's stoppage-time own-goal helped Inter Milan claim a 2-1 win at Hellas Verona and close the gap on Serie A leaders Napoli to one point.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter Milan score late winner to beat Verona

headlines.description: Inter Milan beat Lazio 2-0 at the San Siro to go top of Serie A.
headlines.shortLinkText: Two-goal Inter beat Lazio to go top of Serie A

headlines.description: David Neres provided two goals and an assist to help Napoli beat Atalanta 3-1 and move top of Serie A on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Napoli go top as Neres double downs Atalanta

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic's goal was the difference as AC Milan beat rivals Inter Milan 1-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic leads Milan to derby win, second in Serie A

headlines.description: Napoli moved level with AC Milan at the top of Serie A after David Neres' first-half strike proved enough to sink title rivals Roma at the Stadio Olimpico.
headlines.shortLinkText: Napoli beat Roma away to go level atop Serie A

headlines.description: Two goals from Rasmus Hojlund helped Napoli go top of Serie A on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rasmus Højlund at the double as Napoli go top of Serie A

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic came off the bench to score a pair of second-half goals and lead AC Milan to a 3-2 comeback win over Torino in Serie A on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic scores 2 off bench to put Milan atop Serie A

headlines.description: Teenage defender Davide Bartesaghi scored his first senior goals but couldn't prevent AC Milan from being held to a 2-2 draw at home to Sassuolo in Serie A on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic goal disallowed as AC Milan draw with Sassuolo

headlines.description: Inter Milan capitalised on slip-ups from their rivals as they moved top of Serie A with a 2-1 win at Genoa.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter tops Serie A after rivals slip over weekend

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic is on pace for the best season of his career -- in a season that will conclude with a home World Cup played in the United States.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic nets in Milan win, on pace for best campaign

headlines.description: Rasmus Højlund's first-half brace saw Napoli build on their Italian Super Cup success with a 2-0 win at Jamie Vardy's Cremonese on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund scores twice against Vardy's Cremonese

headlines.description: Weston McKennie scored but Jonathan David had a penalty saved as Juventus were held to a surprise 1-1 draw by relegation-threatened Lecce on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McKennie scores, David misses pen in Juve draw

headlines.description: Inter Milan fought for a 2-0 victory on a foggy night at Parma on Wednesday to move four points clear at the top of Serie A.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter Milan extend Serie A lead with win at Parma

headlines.description: AC Milan missed the chance to close in on Serie A leader Inter Milan as it was held to a 1-1 draw at home with relegation-threatened Genoa on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milan ride late drama to home draw with Genoa

headlines.description: A brace from Scott McTominay helped Napoli to a 2-2 draw against title rivals Inter Milan.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scott McTominay brace earns Napoli a draw against title rivals Inter Milan

headlines.description: Juventus climbed to third in the Serie A standings with a 5-0 thrashing of Cremonese on Monday, featuring goals from five different players, among them U.S. midfielder Weston McKennie.
headlines.shortLinkText: McKennie scores in dominant Juventus victory

headlines.description: Pio Esposito's late goal powered Inter past Lecce, securing the 'Winter Championship' and extending their lead at the top of the Serie A table.
headlines.shortLinkText: Esposito strikes late to extend Inter's Serie A lead

headlines.description: AC Milan won 3-1 at in-form Como on Thursday, with Adrien Rabiot winning a penalty and then scoring two goals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic stays on bench as Rabiot inspires Milan win

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic back in XI as Milan win, keep Inter in sight
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic back in XI as Milan win, keep Inter in sight

headlines.description: Inter Milan stretched their lead at the top of Serie A to six points, but only after coming from two goals down to beat lowly Pisa 6-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Six-star Inter go six points clear at top of Serie A

headlines.description: Juventus dealt Napoli's Serie A title defence a major blow as they swept to a 3-0 win at the Allianz Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juventus impose setback on Napoli title defence

headlines.description: AC Milan dropped five points behind Serie A leaders and rivals Inter Milan with a 1-1 draw at AS Roma on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: AC Milan lose ground on Inter after Roma draw

headlines.description: Lautaro Martínez is closing in on more records for Inter Milan. The Argentinian World Cup winner scored again on Sunday to set league leader Inter on its way to a 2-0 win at Cremonese in Serie A.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter Milan beat Cremonese to extend Serie A lead

headlines.description: Rasmus Højlund scored a last-gasp penalty as 10-man Napoli won 3-2 at Genoa in Serie A on Saturday, keeping pressure on the top two clubs from Milan.
headlines.shortLinkText: Højlund, McTominay goals give Napoli thrilling win

headlines.description: Pierre Kalulu scored six minutes into stoppage time as fourth-place Juventus salvaged a 2-2 home draw with eighth-place Lazio, coming back from two goals down.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kalulu late goal salvages Juventus draw with Lazio

headlines.description: Luka Modric scored a late winner for AC Milan to beat Pisa 2-1 and close the gap on Serie A leader Inter Milan to five points on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic comes off bench as Modric gives Milan win

headlines.description: Piotr Zielinski's last-minute winner sent Inter Milan eight points clear at the top of the Serie A table as they finally got the better of 10-man Juventus.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter beat 10-man Juve in dramatic Derby d'Italia

headlines.description: AC Milan fell seven points behind Inter Milan in the Italian title race after drawing 1-1 at home to Como on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: AC Milan drop points at home against Como

headlines.description: Romelu Lukaku's first goal of the season with the last kick of the match ended Napoli's winless run on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lukaku's 1st goal of season gives Napoli late win

headlines.description: AC Milan needed two late goals to secure a 2-0 win at Cremonese in Serie A on Sunday and bounce back from its second loss of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic's Milan score late double, 10 pts off Inter

headlines.description: Juventus avoided a nightmare finish to their week after they salvaged a 3-3 draw against Roma in Serie A.
headlines.shortLinkText: Juve avoid 3rd straight loss, draw 3-3 at Roma

headlines.description: AC Milan cut Inter Milan's lead at the top of Serie A to seven points after a 1-0 victory in the derby at San Siro.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milan complete derby double to close in on Inter

headlines.description: A Scott McTominay goal saw Napoli win 1-0 at Cagliari to move into second place in Serie A on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McTominay goal takes in-form Napoli up to 2nd

headlines.description: Christian Pulisic registered his first goal contribution of 2026 as AC Milan changed gears in the second half to storm to a 3-2 win over Torino on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic ends drought as Milan close gap to Inter

headlines.description: After falling out of the Serie A title race, AC Milan is looking nervously at the teams behind it following a shock 3-0 loss at home to Udinese on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pulisic's Milan jeered off after shock Udinese loss

headlines.description: AC Milan boosted its chances of qualifying for next season's Champions League and moved back into second spot in Serie A with a 1-0 win at last-placed Hellas Verona.
headlines.shortLinkText: AC Milan boosts UCL push with win at Verona

headlines.description: Inter Milan saw their title push put on ice after Torino mounted a late fightback to draw 2-2 at the Stadio Olimpico.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter made to wait on Serie A title with Torino draw

headlines.description: AC Milan are falling into danger of losing their Champions League place as city rivals Inter Milan close in on the Serie A title.
headlines.shortLinkText: AC Milan UCL spot in danger after Sassuolo loss

headlines.description: Inter Milan regained the Serie A title with three games to spare after beating head coach Cristian Chivu's former club Parma 2-0 at the San Siro.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inter Milan win 21st Serie A title with victory over Parma
